statement: The status values carrying normative behaviour are exactly those classified in §4.6.1 (draft, proposed, accepted, rejected) with the unstated case; any other value is conventional and an implementation MUST NOT attach behaviour to it beyond REC-032 and the unrecognized-status row.
note: Five records with statuses accepted / proposed / superseded / open / rejected. EXACTLY ONE (rejected) is excluded. `superseded` and `open` in particular look like they should be filtered and MUST NOT be: superseded intent is still real intent that was once acted on, and filtering it silently deletes history.
